name: claude-octopus
description: Unofficial. A pixel pet that grows with your Claude Code context — click it to /compact.

commands.title: Claude Octopus: Cycle Motion Level (lively / calm / minimal)

claudeOctopus.contextWindow.description: Context window size in tokens. Switches to 1,000,000 automatically if usage exceeds this value.

claudeOctopus.compactThreshold.description: Fraction of the context window at which the octopus counts as 'full' and a single click runs /compact.

enumDescriptions: Most recently active session of the open workspace folder(s); falls back to the latest session anywhere.
Most recently active Claude Code session in any project.

claudeOctopus.terminalNamePattern.description: Case-insensitive regex used to find the terminal that runs Claude Code. If no single terminal matches you are asked to pick one. User settings only: a workspace cannot change it.

claudeOctopus.confirmBelowThreshold.description: Ask before running /compact when the context is still below the threshold (double-click).

claudeOctopus.sleepAfterMinutes.description: The octopus falls asleep after this many minutes without session activity.

enumDescriptions: All animations, including the flashing 'about to burst' effects at 100%.
No flashing or view shaking; slower pulses and fewer idle antics. Easy on the eyes while coding.
Almost still: only size, colour and gentle breathing. No particles or wandering.

claudeOctopus.size.description: Size multiplier for the octopus (it still grows with the context inside this size, and never outgrows the view).

enumDescriptions: Its own icon in the Activity Bar.
A small section inside the Explorer sidebar.
A tab in the bottom panel, next to the terminal.
No view at all — only the status bar item.

claudeOctopus.quietWhileTyping.description: Hold still (no particles, speech or wandering) for a few seconds after every edit you make.

claudeOctopus.showSpeech.description: Show speech bubbles. Important alerts (context full) are always shown.

claudeOctopus.showStatusBar.description: Show the context percentage in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Detect from the transcript (which cache bucket Claude wrote to); falls back to 1 hour.
claudeOctopus.cacheTtl.description: How long Claude's prompt cache lives. Once it expires the octopus goes into deep sleep: the next message has to re-read the whole context.

enumDescriptions: Pick by date: Messi farewell (6/10/2026), birthday 24/6 and 18/12 · 20/10 and 8/3 · Christmas · Lunar New Year (Tet).
Argentina jersey, beard, captain armband, football and three stars. GOAT 🐐
Flower crown, a rose and falling petals for Vietnamese Women's Day (20 Oct) and International Women's Day (8 Mar).
Lanterns, red envelopes and apricot blossoms for Lunar New Year (Tet).

claudeOctopus.themeDates.markdownDescription: Extra dates for themes (they win over built-in ones). Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` or yearly `MM-DD`, e.g. `[{ "theme": "messi", "from": "2026-10-03", "to": "2026-10-07" }]`.

claudeOctopus.vibeAfterSeconds.description: After Claude has been working non-stop this long, the octopus switches to vibe mode: sunglasses, headphones and bubble tea while you wait.

claudeOctopus.boredAfterSeconds.description: After this long without any session activity the octopus gets bored (before it eventually falls asleep).

claudeOctopus.knowledgeLabels.description: Show short labels (file names, command descriptions, the start of your prompt) on the knowledge chips the octopus eats. Anything that looks like a secret is always masked; turn this off to show icons only, e.g. while screen sharing.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the settings that choose which terminal /compact is typed into and which sessions are read cannot be set by the workspace.
